notes.title: 1.5.1 Update
notes.content: New screen resolutions, fixed UI problems caused by aspect ratio, fixed boxing ring collisions, better rope physics, limits for selecting too easy or hard opponent, able to pause game in fights, some bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.5.0 Update
notes.content: New design for fight arena, changed lighting of gym and fight arena, new ring rope system with physics, bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.4.0 Update
notes.content: Trainers to train punches, different stats for different punch styles, solved a problem about fighter records, more aggressive ai behaviour, frame rate limit setting, bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.3.2 Update
notes.content: Camera shake effects, screen effects, better camera movement, new ui for health and stamina bar, fixed collision issues.

notes.title: 1.3.1 Update
notes.content: Speed stat and stamina can effect movement speed, boxers ability to get up increases with the current stamina of the boxer, some adjustments for difficulties, bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.3.0 Update
notes.content: More balanced gameplay, improved ai behaviour, new punch sound effects, punch particle effects, fixed damage of close range punches, body shots can drain stamina, bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.2.2 Update
notes.content: Count down fixed, bug fixes, crash fix.

notes.title: 1.2 Update
notes.content: Difficulty selection, better ai behaviour, better ui design, improved ragdoll collisions and limits, changes in uppercut animation, better blocking system, changes in tutorial, bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content: Able to play as boxer, bug fixes.
